Extranet Resource Add Extranet
POST
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/extranet

Adds a new extranet for the organization. Extranets are configured as part of Zscaler Extranet Application Support which allows an organization to connect its internal network with another organization’s network (e.g., partners, third-party vendors, etc.) that does not use the Zscaler service. Extranet Application Support enables Zscaler-managed organization users to securely access extranet resources through an IPSec VPN tunnel established between the Zscaler data center and the external organization’s data center, without requiring additional hardware or software installations.

To learn more, see Understanding Extranet Application Support and Configuring an Extranet.

Request
​
APPLICATION/JSON
BODY

Information about the extranet

id
int32

The unique identifier for the extranet

name
string

The name of the extranet

description
string

The description of the extranet

extranetDNSList
object[]
extranetIpPoolList

Information about the traffic selectors specified for the extranet. Type: Array

createdAt
int32

The Unix timestamp when the extranet was created

modifiedAt
int32

The Unix timestamp when the extranet was last modified

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
